simple.summary: חֲשׂוּפָא (Chăsûwphâʼ) means Chasupha , one of the Nethinim First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 43.

definitions.full: H2817. Chasupha חֲשֻׁפָא חֲשׂוּפָא, proper name, masculine head of a family of Nethinim among the returning exiles חֲשׂוּפָא Ezra 2:43 = חֲשֻׂפָא Neh 7:46 .
